audit.whatIsWrong: The page states three times that Bouncing Bomb 'out-ranges your Rupture by a mile'. Bouncing Bomb is 850 range and Rupture is 950 - Cho'Gath has the longer cast. Satchel Charge's percent-health scaling is also never mentioned.
audit.why: The reversed range claim is why the whole page reads as unplayable: it tells a Cho'Gath player he can never answer the poke, when in fact he can open the knockup from outside it and walk in behind. Satchel Charge additionally carries the percentHealth flag, so it is the one thing in the kit that gets stronger as you stack Feast.
audit.corrected: Rupture reaches 950 against Bouncing Bomb's 850. Feral Scream denies the Satchel Charge cast, which is his only self-displace on 20 seconds at rank 1, and Satchel scales off your maximum health.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ziggs.json (Q 850 6/5.5/5/4.5/4, W 1000 20/18/16/14/12 knockup+percentHealth, E 16s 900, R 120/95/70 at 5000)

audit.whatIsWrong: Rated 8.5/10 difficulty with a red tone and five of seven stages given to Ziggs - including level 6 and both item stages - against a 58.15% Cho'Gath win rate over 184 games, the most favourable matchup in this slice. The label 'FAV' sat on top of an 8.5/10 difficulty and a red tone, which contradict each other.
audit.why: The page's own prose says the lane stabilises your way at 4-5, that Feast at 6 makes 'any step into your range a death sentence', and that late 'this is yours'. Only levels 1-3 belong to Ziggs.
audit.corrected: FAV, 4.5/10, green tone; chart Skill / Ziggs / Ziggs / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath with ratings 5,4,4,6,7,7,8.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and Satchel Charge was treated as an ever-present escape.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s - the gap between casts is the entire all-in window. Bouncing Bomb is 6 down to 4s, Hexplosive Minefield a flat 16s, and Mega Inferno Bomb 120/95/70s from 5000 range, which is a map threat rather than a lane one.
audit.corrected: Commit on Satchel Charge's 20 seconds; treat the bomb's 6 seconds as chip you heal through on Carnivore.

audit.why: It is flagged as an auto-attack reset and its cooldown is reduced every time he casts an ability, so a Ziggs who has just thrown two spells has an empowered attack ready - the wind-up is a tell, not the ability cast.
audit.corrected: Noted the reset in the do's alongside the poke-step punish.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are Ziggs' show — his Bouncing Bomb (Q) out-ranges your Rupture by a mile and hops over the wave, so you simply cannot trade back, and his Hexplosive Minefield (E) zones you off the caster minions. Don't try to walk him down here: you have no gap-closer and no dash, and chasing a bounced bomb just feeds him free pokes. Last-hit with the tip of Vorpal Spikes, lean on Carnivore to heal back every chip and stay mana-topped, and respect that his Satchel Charge will boop him out of range the instant you commit.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are Ziggs' show, but not because he out-ranges you - Rupture reaches 950 and Bouncing Bomb only 850. What beats you early is frequency: the bomb is a 6-second cooldown that hops the wave, and Hexplosive Minefield zones you off the caster minions on a flat 16. Don't try to walk him down yet; you have no dash, and chasing a bounced bomb just feeds him the next one. Last-hit with the tip of Vorpal Spikes, lean on Carnivore to heal the chip and stay mana-topped, and remember Satchel Charge will boop him out the instant you commit.

edits.before: By 4-5 your Carnivore sustain, Vorpal Spikes waveclear, and Rupture-into-Feral-Scream combo stabilize the lane — you heal the bomb poke faster than he can re-stack mana to throw it. Level 6 flips the matchup: Feast is a true-damage execute that ignores his zero resistances, so if he ever steps into Satchel range to poke, you Rupture the knockup, Feral Scream the silence to deny his Satchel self-displace, and Feast the kill. The whole sequence hinges on catching him before he can W himself to safety — so punish his poke step, not his retreat.
edits.after: By 4-5 your Carnivore sustain and Vorpal Spikes waveclear stabilise the lane, and the range fact starts paying: you can open Rupture from 950, outside his 850 bomb, and walk in behind the knockup. Level 6 finishes the argument - Feast is 175-range true damage and he buys no resistances, so any step into your range is fatal. The sequence hinges on the silence: Feral Scream denies Satchel Charge, his only self-displace, and that is 20 seconds at rank 1. Punish his poke step, never his retreat.

notes: The reversed range claim here is the same class of error as the Vladimir pool-timing one: a single wrong number that the whole page was built around, and in this case it turned a 58% matchup into a page that reads as a losing lane. Worth a file-wide check of any 'out-ranges your Rupture' phrasing, since Rupture's 950 is longer than most of what it was being compared against. All five packet suspectNames for this matchup ('Bouncing Bomb's', 'Feral Scream's', 'Drop Hexplosive Minefield', 'Use Satchel Charge', 'His Bouncing Bomb') are false positives on correct names with possessives or leading verbs. Also: chogath.json tags Rupture with grounding, a tooltip-parse misfire on 'Ruptures the ground' (same on Malphite Q and Olaf Q), so I asserted only the knockup.
